title: RGNUL's CIIPR To Organise International Seminar On Inclusive Labour Law Regime In India
description: The Centre for Innovation and Intellectual Property Rights (CIIPR), Rajiv Gandhi National University of Law (RGNUL), Punjab, in collaboration with Law Mantra Trust, is organising a two-day International Seminar on "Inclusive Labour Law Regime in India: Addressing Women Workers, Child Labour, and Informal Economy" on 16 and 17 October 2026.
